capabilities: Save the current file as a private Gist
Save the current selection as a private Gist
Copy the created Gist URL to the clipboard
Configure a GitHub API token in settings
extras: README notes current limits: only private Gists can be created and existing Gists cannot be updated.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to share a note externally as a GitHub Gist.

requires.name: GitHub API token with Create Gist permission

summary: Export plugin that saves the current note or selection as a private GitHub Gist and copies the Gist URL to the clipboard.
